closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin B12, protein, and iron, but the biggest weaknesses are low potassium, low collagen, and cholesterol. It is good for blood and oxygen support, immune support, and muscles because vitamin B12 and iron supports the blood-and-oxygen side, zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist, and protein still gives it a muscle-support angle.
